resources.string: Ends rewarded ads the moment they start and still gives you the reward. Also skips interstitial and app-open ads and hides banners.
Enabled in LSPosed. Changes apply right away, no need to restart your games.
Enable NoAds in the LSPosed manager and pick your games, then force stop and reopen them.
End the ad the moment it starts and still get the reward
Close full-screen ads between levels instantly
Skip the ad shown while an app starts
Never load banner ads and hide their space
The ad is never shown, so no advertiser pays for it. NoAds never reports fake impressions, clicks or revenue, and never bypasses anti-cheat.
Games that check rewards on their own servers (most online games) can\'t be helped. Skipping ads may break a game\'s terms of service, and online games may ban you for it.
Log every blocked banner and hooked class to logcat and the LSPosed log, for bug reports
